SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE - DEPARTMENT 514. JUDGE: THOMAS J. MELLON, JR.; CLERK: DAN MACDUFF; REPORTER: MARY J. HINDS. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF BY ANA BOLTON-ARGUELLO AND DEMETRICE MADARIS, WITH COUNSEL, ARNOLD W. EVJE; DEFENDANT IN PRO PER. THE CASE SETTLES ON THE RECORD AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT TO MAKE 6 PAYMENTS TO PLAINTIFF, IN THE AMOUNT OF $424.41, ON 2/1, 2/16, 3/1, 3/16, 4/1 AND 1/16/04. DEFENDANT TO AVOID CONTACT WITH TIM WOODSEN. EACH SIDE TO PAY THEIR OWN ATTORNEY FEES AND COSTS. IF DEFENDANT COMPLIES WITH THE FOREGOING, PLAINTIFF AGREES TO DISMISS THIS CASE. IF DEFENDANT DOES NOT COMPLY, PLAINTIFFS MAY SEEK A JUDGMENT EX PARTE FOR RESTITUTION OF THE PREMISES, FORFEITURE OF THE LEASE, UD DAMAGES OF $1,157.50 (LESS ANY AMOUNTS PAID), FOR THE PERIOD 11/16/03 THROUGH 1/31/04. THE TRIAL DATE IS VACATED.
MASTER JURY CALENDAR SET FOR JAN-12-2004 VACATED. CASE SETTLED.
